BrochureContent.Content:
Stunning 3-Bedroom Coastal Residence Overlooking Dunmanus Bay Standing On c.0.30Acres

Set along the breath taking Wild Atlantic Way, this exceptional 3-bedroom coastal property offers panoramic views across the serene waters of Dunmanus Bay. Blending natural beauty with modern comfort, this home provides a rare opportunity to experience coastal living at its finest.
Nestled in a scenic setting just 6 km from Durrus Village and 12 km to Bantry town. The property enjoys both privacy and convenience being within short driving distance of Ballydehob and the charming harbour village of Schull. Surrounded by rolling countryside and rugged coastline, it is an ideal base for those seeking tranquility while remaining within easy reach of local amenities, schools, cafés, and shops.  
The property comprises of living/dining room, kitchen, utility room, bathroom, three bedrooms, with the master bedroom  thoughtfully designed to maximise light and views having double doors onto an external deck area which benefits from stunning sea vistas and amazing sun sets, creating a peaceful retreat to unwind. The residence stands on a c.0.30 acre site laid out in lawn with shrub beds and mature hedging to most of its boundaries with parking areas to front and rear of the residence. 
An open-plan living and dining area forms the heart of the home.  A well-appointed modern kitchen offers both functionality and style, perfect for everyday living.  Adjacent to the property there is a traditional single storey stone built workshop/storehouse. 
The property is set on a sheltered site with well-maintained grounds. An outdoor decked  seating areas provide the perfect vantage point to enjoy sunsets over the Atlantic, while the surrounding landscape offers space for relaxation or recreation. 
This home is ideal as a permanent residence, holiday retreat. With nearby walking routes, water activities, and the charm of West Cork on your doorstep, it offers a lifestyle defined by nature, peace, and understated luxury.
This is a rare opportunity to acquire a coastal haven in one of Ireland’s most sought-after scenic locations.
Viewing highly recommended.

Hallway, Living/Dining Room, Kitchen, Utility Room, 3 Bedrooms, Bathroom.
